name: ATMA Browser
subtitle: Websites, tabs and profiles
promotionalText: Browse websites, save shortcuts and keep site sessions in separate profiles. No ATMA account or in-app purchases required.
description:
ATMA is a browser for iPhone and iPad that helps you organize websites and return to the pages you use.

YOUR WEBSITES, TOGETHER
Save website shortcuts on the ATMA start page, organize them into folders and choose your appearance. Each shortcut keeps the profile used when you created it.

SEPARATE PROFILES
Keep site sessions in separate profiles. Changing the profile in an ordinary tab does not change a saved shortcut's profile. Sign-in persistence also depends on the website's cookies and account rules.

TABS AND SEARCH
Enter addresses, choose a search engine and switch between tabs with page snapshots.

MORE ROOM FOR THE PAGE
Open saved websites with a compact bottom toolbar. Back, forward, address, reload and the ATMA home button remain within reach.

CONTROL LOCAL DATA
Inspect and delete cookies in the selected profile, manage ordinary downloads and keep selected links on a PIN-protected page. The PIN protects that page of links; it does not make website visits anonymous.

MEDIA CONTROLS
Control compatible video and audio. Picture in Picture and background playback depend on the website, the media and iOS.

ATMA is free, with no in-app purchases or ATMA subscriptions. No ATMA account is needed. Websites you open may offer their own paid services under their own terms.

ATMA uses Apple's WebKit. Profiles change the User-Agent and the mobile or desktop website mode; they do not emulate a different physical device, browser engine or screen size.
